EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Father Paul Frolick, of St. Andrews Catholic Church at 306 N. Division, expressed concern about the elimination of on-street parking on Catherine Street. He urged Council to reconsider the plan as these parking spaces are needed for Church members to access services on Sundays. He also stated access to the Church's parking lot during construction is needed in order to maintain the services they provide daily to community members.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Paul Frolick - Catherine Street On-Street Parking (CA-4) (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Chuck Ream, resident, spoke about the City's proposed Comprehensive Land Use Plan.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Chuck Ream - Comprehensive Land Use Plan (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Alex Lowe, resident, spoke about the reconstruction of the Library space at 319 S. Fifth Avenue.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Alex Lowe - 319 S. Fifth Ave (Zoom)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote: Kathy Griswold, resident, expressed concern about pedestrian safety at various intersections in the City.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: Kathy Griswold - Pedestrians forced to walk in busy street (in person)

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote:
COUNCILMEMBER RADINA

Councilmember Radina spoke about the state of national politics, including the presence of masked ICE agents in Minnesota. He urged residents to use their privileges to fight for those who are being oppressed.


COUNCILMEMBER AKMON

Councilmember Akmon stated she is not running for a second term on City Council. She thanked all of those who she has worked with and those who voted for her.


COUNCILMEMBER BRIGGS

Councilmember Briggs thanked Police Chief Anderson for putting together a Town Hall meeting for those affected by the threats at Haisley Elementary.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: COMMUNICATIONS FROM COUNCIL

EventItems.EventItemMinutesNote:
MAYOR TAYLOR

Mayor Taylor addressed the comments made by Councilmember Radina, stating these are unprecedented times. He stated the City will not actively cooperate with federal agents when they are targeting our residents. He stated he hears the community as well on this matter.
EventItems.EventItemTitle: COMMUNICATIONS FROM THE MAYOR
